decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would result in a cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would fail to meet the Council's standards for minimum room sizes, layout and private amenity space. The proposal would therefore result in substandard living accommodation detrimental to the living conditions of the existing residents and future occupants of the proposed accommodation, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards).

Condition : 2 - The proposed two-storey rear extension, due to its excessive bulk and depth, overbearing appearance and the relative position to the rear elevation and terrace of the existing first floor residential accommodation, would harm the character of the original building and the area and would result in a loss of light, outlook and privacy to the adjoining neighbours. The proposal would therefore fail to accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development) and H.4.1 (Housing standards and guidelines).

Condition : 3 - The proposed development would fail to comply with the Council's parking, refuse/recycling and off-street servicing standards and would prejudice the free flow of traffic and general safety in the area, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments).
description: Change of use of ground floor office to restaurant incorporating the erection of a two storey rear extension comprising additional restaurant facilities, 1 x one- bed flat and 1 x two-bed flat.
